<thought>Search for retrosynthetic templates that break an acyl chloride and form a carboxylic ester, which matches the target methyl ester. This will give a template that can be applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["carboxylic esters"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
